subject.title: fix(infra): bound stalled provider JSON/text/binary response reads with default chunk timeout

question: Should provider JSON/text and error-body helpers impose inherited 30-second and 10-second idle defaults on all existing callers, or should timeout policy remain caller-scoped after the media-core refactor?
rationale: The patch fixes a real unbounded-read bug, but fixed inherited defaults can intentionally turn previously successful slow responses into failures, and repository policy treats default and fallback changes as compatibility-sensitive.

options.title: Accept bounded shared defaults
options.body: Keep the 30-second success-body and 10-second error-body defaults after rebasing and require focused delayed-response compatibility proof.

options.title: Require caller-scoped timeouts
options.body: Expose timeout options through the canonical helpers but make each provider transport choose its own idle budget.

recommendation.title: Accept bounded shared defaults
recommendation.body: Keep the 30-second success-body and 10-second error-body defaults after rebasing and require focused delayed-response compatibility proof.

likelyOwner.reason: They introduced the existing chunk-timeout machinery and have the strongest concrete history on the same stalled-read invariant.
